body: Rust-colored grit from the well study coats the fertilizer sack. The empty sprayer ran dry during the second application. The wheat in that plot turned black within a week.
title: fertilizer and empty sprayer

body: They painted an arrow to the exit, then shifted the barrier beyond the last turn. I walked back for my mother, who cannot climb the ditch. By then the painted arrow was covered and the man with the clipboard said he had seen no one.
